title: Retrospective of a pipeline run (annex B section B.20, owner 106; F106-FR-034, F106-FR-035)

pipeline.description: Id of the pipeline the retrospective is about

contract_digest.description: The launch contract hash the retrospective was computed against; the retrospective is filed under it (field name as at the baseline)

generated_at.description: Local time with offset, to the second, as at the baseline

reason.description: Present when the status is unavailable; passed through the one ingress (F106-FR-040)

workdir.description: Working directory of the located feature

summary_schema.description: Schema id of the summary that learn --summarize returned

totals.description: The totals of that summary, copied

phases.description: Per phase: title, attempts_total, attempts_to_approval, cost_usd, work_sec_p50, work_sec_p90, work_sec_samples, copied from the summary

evaluations.description: The evaluation lines, as the learn command reports them; passed through the one ingress (F106-FR-040)

suggestions.description: The suggestion lines; a suggestion is never run
